name: tdarr-control
description: Control of a Tdarr distributed transcoding server (v2 API). Generic passthrough over all 67 documented /api/v2 endpoints plus ~30 curated tools for status, library (search-db, scan, delete, filescanner control), plugins (search/read/install/create/edit/delete/sync), nodes (list/restart/disconnect/logs/worker-limits), backups, the powerful /cruddb (8 collections, full CRUD), codec-exclude and plugin-include management, transcode-user-verdict, and flow templates. LIVE-VERIFIED on Tdarr 2.84.01 (2026-07-20): 16/16 smoke tools pass + reversible backup create/delete proof. All writes confirm-gated; /cruddb writes and node lifecycle ops (kill-worker, disconnect-node) doubly-gated.
